validation.text: Each forecast is the course the patient would follow without treatment, learned from patients not yet treated, plus the effect of the strategy, learned from how far the patients who started it moved from their own untreated forecast. Each part of the twin was chosen among competing designs on the patients of 2023 and judged on the patients of 2024 and 2025, refitted every year; its effects were checked against independent doubly robust estimates and randomised trials. At a later visit, the weights since the start, whether the patient is taking the medicine and the dose reached update the forecast. Complication risks are the untreated risk times the strategy's risk ratio, calibrated on outcomes no strategy can change within two years, or taken from a randomised trial where the records are biased.
